title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Priya Nair
description: Summary: Enforce KMS region pinning across RBAC v2 resources and harden audit logging for KMS operations. Motivation: customers in regulated regions require cryptographic keys and key usage to be region-resident and auditable. This change implements enforcement logic, improves audit payloads for KMS calls, and provides upgrade-safe rollout flags. Changes include policy validation, runtime enforcement hooks, audit schema augmentation, unit/integration tests, and documentation. Scope: redwood control plane (rbac/v2 policy evaluation), audit service (audit/logging/*), installer and config defaults, and SDK compatibility notes for Key metadata. Checklist: 1) Policy validation: deny create/update when key.region != allowed_regions for a given org/policy binding. 2) Enforcement: middleware in rbac enforcer that rejects operations or marks them for 'audit-only' based on policy mode. 3) Audit augmentation: include key_residency and kms_key_id fields in KMS audit events; ensure events are emitted for fallback/redirect scenarios. 4) Feature flag: rollout via feature flag security.kms_region_residency.enforce (default: audit-only) with a migration period. 5) Tests: new unit tests and an integration test that simulates a multi-region key binding. 6) Docs: update RBAC v2 policy reference and runbook for incidents. Migration and rollout: default behavior is audit-only; customers can opt-in to enforcement after a 2-week audit window. Operations playbook and alerting: added an alert when audit-only violations exceed threshold for an org. Backwards compatibility: no breaking API changes; policy schema extended with optional residency constraints. Related: Linear ENG-7624, SEC-341, PM-1281.

review_comments: Ethan Cole (reviewer): Can we add a short-circuit earlier in the enforcer to avoid looking up KMS metadata for stateless read-only checks? This was a perf hotspot in prior attempts.

Priya Nair (author): Added short-circuit in enforcer; metadata lookup now gated by policy that references residency. See enforcer.go line 218. Benchmarked locally, median latency impact <1ms per request.
Marta Alvarez (reviewer): Audit payload looks good. Please include the full kms_key_id when available (not just truncated). Also suggest a follow-up to ensure downstream SIEM mappings are updated.
Priya Nair (author): Switched to full kms_key_id in events. Added follow-up Linear item ENG-7710 for SIEM mapping and provided a compatibility note in docs.
Jason Li (approver): Security review complete. Approving — please ensure rollouts use the audit-only default and coordinate with SRE for alert thresholds.
release_notes: Enforceable KMS region residency constraints for RBAC v2 policies with improved audit logging for KMS operations. Default rollout is audit-only; admins can opt into enforcement after a migration window. See docs/rbac/v2/kms-region-residency.md for migration steps and runbook.
